criteria.text: One atomic openProjectSession(projectId, sessionId) flow: switch/confirm project -> load/verify target session -> load transcript/state (via MSP-001 hydration seams) -> commit selection. No intermediate/partial state may be observable by the UI until commit.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c1: cross-project deep link commits one complete snapshot

criteria.text: Generation/cancellation guards: a later open invalidates all in-flight work from earlier opens. Rapid navigation must never interleave stale results into the UI.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c2: rapid navigation cannot commit the stale first target

criteria.text: A bounded loading timeout — pick and document a concrete value.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c3: the documented loading deadline terminates in timeout

criteria.text: Distinct terminal states, each rendered differently, each with Retry + Back: missing session, unauthorized/stale project, offline, timeout, transient error.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c4: every terminal state has distinct copy plus Retry and Back

criteria.text: Retry must not duplicate subscriptions or create new sessions.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c5: retry is idempotent and never creates a session or duplicates a subscription

criteria.text: Back must cancel stale in-flight work and return to the session list.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c6: Back cancels pending work before returning to the chat list

criteria.text: Cold start opens the requested session without exposing a fallback session or creating a new one.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c7: cold start commits only the requested existing session

criteria.text: Background resume does not reopen, resubscribe, or replace an already committed target.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c8: background resume is idempotent for the committed target

criteria.text: Offline opening terminates in the offline state without committing partial selection.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c9: offline gateway failure is terminal and preserves selection

criteria.text: Missing sessions, unauthorized/stale projects, and transient failures remain distinguishable and never commit.
criteria.test_id: issue-4-c10: missing unauthorized and transient failures stay distinct

criteria.text: Document any manual native checks needed for the parity gate that cannot be covered by these tests.
criteria.reason: Requires a physical iPhone/native Expo lifecycle to confirm OS background-resume timing, hardware Back/navigation behavior, and accessibility focus; action safety forbids starting a server or using production data in this workstream.
